newsitem.title: USA: Champion Enterprises adds to stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Champion Enterprises adds to stock buyback.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc. said Thursday that its board of directors had authorized the addition of 1.5 million shares to its common stock repurchase program.
Added to the 2.5 million share repurchase program approved on April 29, the manufactured home and bus company's total buyback program now amounts to four million shares.
Champion recently announced that through July 15, 1997 it had acquired 1.67 million shares of the initial stock repurchase authorization.
With the expansion approved today, the company can acquire as much as 2.3 million additional shares over the next two years. It currently has 47.1 million shares outstanding.
In a statement, Champion Chairman Walter Young said the company's stock is currently undervalued, closing unchanged Thursday at 15-1/2, near its 12-month low of 13-12/16.

"Given our long-term outlook, we believe at these price levels, the repurchase of our stock is an outstanding investment," Young said. "Our strong cash flow from operations and virtually debt-free balance sheet allow us the flexibility to expand our stock repurchase program and continue the growth of the company through internal expansions and acquisitions."
